idea-plugin.name: Agentry
idea-plugin.description:
Browse, install, and manage agent skills/manifests from git repositories. Supports Claude Code, Junie, GitHub Copilot, and other coding agents.
  • Browse skills from git-hosted registries (any branch/tag/commit)
  • Install skills to .claude/, .junie/, or ~/.agentry/
  • Project-level .agentry/config.yaml for team skill sharing
  • Trust-on-first-use auto-sync; live reload on config edits
  • Headless CLI mode (idea agentry list / install / remove)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2
  • Default install target flips from CLAUDE_PROJECT to CLAUDE_USER — new installs land under ~/.claude/ instead of the open project. Existing users keep their persisted setting.
  • Tool-window footer gains an Install to: [User ▾] picker so individual install / uninstall clicks can target user OR project scope without round-tripping through Settings.
  • Tree rows show install location as a compact [U] / [P] / [U][P] badge, placed immediately after the name so long descriptions can't push it off the right edge.
  • Install is additive (installing at one scope never removes from the other); uninstall is per-scope.
  • InstallTarget enum trimmed to CLAUDE_USER + CLAUDE_PROJECT; persisted values for the removed AGENTRY_CACHE and JUNIE_PROJECT coerce to CLAUDE_USER on load.
  • Fix: ComponentActions previously hardcoded InstallScope.Project whenever a project was open, ignoring the user-target setting entirely. Now reads the picker.
0.1.1
  • Address Marketplace verifier warnings: switch the CLI command-name declaration from the deprecated ApplicationStarter.commandName override to the EP's id attribute; pass an explicit CheckPolicy to CheckboxTree (the 2-arg constructor was deprecated in 2025.3); fire tool-window actions through ActionUtil.performActionDumbAwareWithCallbacks instead of calling the override-only AnAction.actionPerformed directly. (One verifier warning is unavoidable until sinceBuild moves to 253 — CheckboxTreeCellRendererBase.getCheckbox() is deprecated on 2025.3+ in favour of threeStateCheckBox, which doesn't exist on 2025.1/2.)
0.1.0
  • Initial release: manifest resolver, install layer, tool window, settings, AnActions + ApplicationStarter for agent / CLI access.
